name: claude
title: Claude ✦ Orbit Console
description: Programmable AI developer console — Python SDK, Rust Job Server, Next.js Terminal UI, IPFS versioning

/folders.docs: List folders under a path with optional search filter

/suggest_folders.docs: Suggest folders using embedcode similarity search

/jobs.docs: Submit a job (auth) or list ALL jobs (public — tasks form a public code ledger)

/jobs/{id}.docs: Get any job by id (public ledger; shareable via QR deep link ?job={id}) or delete your own job (auth)

/jobs/{id}/stream.docs: SSE live stream of job output (public ledger)

/kill.docs: Kill a process by PID or port (owner-only; requires x-sudo signature bound to pid:/port:)

/modules/{name}/process.docs: Manage a module's processes — body {action: status|stop|start|restart, target?: api|app}. Backend is pluggable per module (pm2|systemd|generic) via MOD_PM env or the target module's config.json `process_manager` field (default: auto-detect). Modules shipping a flake.nix/shell.nix get self-launched commands nix-wrapped. Owner-only; status is read-only, and mutating actions on a module other than claude require an x-sudo signature bound to process:{name}. Response includes the resolved `backend` and `nix_env`.

/files/write.docs: Write a file. Untrusted callers are confined to their workspace; trusted callers (owner + whitelisted editors) may write anywhere under ~/mod (incl. core/+orbit/) with just their bearer session — no per-write sudo.

/modules/{name}.docs: Delete a module. Editing a module not personally owned by the caller requires an x-sudo signature from the owner key.

/modules/{name}/restore.docs: Restore a module from a snapshot CID (owner-only; x-sudo required for modules other than claude).

/modules/{name}/mr-fork.docs: Fork a module into the caller's sandboxed workspace, pinned to a base snapshot CID. Any signed-in user; body {refresh?: bool}.

/modules/{name}/merge-requests.docs: List merge requests for a module (public ledger) or open one: {title, description?, head_cid?, base_cid?, message?}. Defaults to snapshotting the caller's fork; raw head_cid makes the MR fully CID-native.

/merge-requests.docs: All merge requests across modules (public ledger).

/merge-requests/{id}.docs: One merge request; lazily folds a finished merge job back into the record (merged/merge_failed + merged_cid).

/merge-requests/{id}/diff.docs: Changed files (base→head) + conflict set vs the CURRENT live tree, computed from snapshot manifests.

/merge-requests/{id}/comment.docs: Comment on an MR: {body, action?: approve|request_changes}. Verdicts require a trusted reviewer (owner or whitelist) and move the MR status.

/merge-requests/{id}/update.docs: Author pushes a new revision: {head_cid?, message?} (re-snapshots their fork by default); reopens a changes_requested MR.

/merge-requests/{id}/close.docs: Close an MR (author or trusted reviewer).

/merge-requests/{id}/merge.docs: AGENTIC MERGE (owner-only): auto-snapshots the live tree, stages base+head from their CIDs, and submits an agent job that three-way merges base/head/live semantically. Body {instructions?, model?}. The job's completion snapshot becomes merged_cid.

/whitelist.docs: List edit-whitelist (GET, public) or add an address (POST, owner-only). Whitelisted addresses are trusted editors: owner-level EDIT access to the orbit (host filesystem, unsandboxed jobs, core/+orbit/ writes), but NOT owner-only powers (whitelist mgmt, set_owner, kill, delete/rename/restore). Stored off-tree in ~/.mod/claude/whitelist.json.

/whitelist/{address}.docs: Remove an address from the edit whitelist (owner-only).
